name: Marriage And Finances
overview: Scripture reveals that marriage is designed by God as a partnership where two become stronger together, sharing in labor and blessings (Genesis 2:18; Ecclesiastes 4:9). Financial wisdom within marriage is emphasized through prudent stewardship, avoiding foolish spending, and preparing an inheritance for future generations (Proverbs 13:22; Proverbs 21:20). The Word also warns of the dangers of debt and the importance of living under God's commandments to guide financial decisions (Proverbs 3:1; Proverbs 22:7). Together, these verses instruct couples to build their financial lives on wisdom, mutual support, and obedience to God’s law.
